title: Exported node references in tool script still reports "ghost" reference even after referenced node is deleted
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible in `4.4.1.stable` and `4.5.dev3`

### System information

Godot v4.5.dev3 - Windows 11 (build 22631) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1660 SUPER (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.6636) - Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-10700F CPU @ 2.90GHz (16 threads)

### Issue description

When a tool script has an exported node reference, and the referenced node is deleted by the user, it still retains the reference to the deleted node, despite showing a blank field in the inspector. This stays true even after saving the scene. The only way to lose the "ghost" reference is to reload the scene. In the meantime, this can cause tool scripts to malfunction and/or crash.

### Steps to reproduce

- Open the attached project/scene.
- Select the root `test` node.
- Click on the `Report` button in the inspector, and note that it prints out the referenced `target` node.
- Delete the `target` node from the scene. Hit save.
- Select the `test` node and click on its `Report` button again, and note that it _still_ prints out the deleted `target` node.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[bug-report.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/20259447/bug-report.zip)
